Candied Walnuts
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Salad
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 6 Cup(s) walnut halves
  • ½ Cup(s) sugar
  • 1 Tablespoon(s) coarse salt
  • ½ Teaspoon(s) cinnamon
  • ¼ Cup(s) brandy
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) vanilla extract
  • 1⅓ Cup(s) maple syrup
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) butter
Instructions
  1. Preheat over to 350. Spread walnuts in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet; toast in oven, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 10 minutes. Let cool completely.
  2. Meanwhile, mix maple sugar, salt, and cinnamon in a medium bowl; set aside. Bring brandy, vanilla, syrup, and butter to a boil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat, and cook until liquid is reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Stir in nuts, and cook, stirring until skillet is almost dry, about 3 minutes more.
  3. Remove from heat, and immediately add reserved sugar mixture; toss until well coated. Spread out coated nuts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper; let cool completely, for 6 hours (or overnight). Store in airtight containers at room temperature up to 2 weeks.
